item.tib: byin rlabs dbang gi yig chung
item.coloph: byin rlabs dbang gi yig chung zhes bya ba/ phyi rab (rabs) ngan 'gro'i don ched du/ stong (stang) chen dmu tsha gyer med kyis/ phyi rab (rabs) las ldan gshen la brgyud pa dge legs 'phel//

item.tib: byin rlabs dbang gi yig chung
item.coloph: slob dpon thugasakyi dril sgrab kyi/ dbang byas man ngag 'dus pa 'di/ yum cig ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis/ dus mtha'i rnal 'byor bdag la snyan du brgyud/ bdag gis sbas dang gsang rgya thub par byas/ dad ldan grogs po'i rkyen gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ dkar chag yi ge ris su bris pa 'di/ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rnams la mthol lo bshags/ bka' skyong srung ma rnams bzod par gsol/ dge ba'i 'gro kun bla med thob par shog/
